records.name: Daddy's Home
records.scope: Factual miniquest gates, fixed consumables, rewards, and POH ownership effect. It does not prescribe opening-route timing.

requirements.notes: Any nail type works. Sixteen successful nails are required, but nails can bend; bringing additional nails is necessary at low Construction. The three waxwood logs and their free conversion are obtained during the miniquest.

economic_gate.classification: Acquisition cost only when the five bolts are bought from the sawmill; already-owned bolts satisfy the gate.

rewards.first_house_branch: A Rimmington player-owned house when the account does not already own a house.

records.model_boundary: The normalized fresh-account action consumes the 16 successful nails and reports additional bent nails as variable. It establishes POH ownership. The mutually exclusive 1,000-coin reward for an account that already owned a house is reported rather than automatically applied because the account predicate language has no negative pre-completion ownership test.
